name: manual_e552b1
claim: Headless agy permits file access inside its active workspace by default. The observed headless failure was a shell-command permission denial, not a universal file-read restriction: scope mitigations to command permission, use direct file review or inline diffs when shell execution is unavailable, and use explicit allowed read-only commands with a hard timeout when shell access is required. Gemini CLI access ended on 2026-06-18 for free, Google AI Pro, and Google AI Ultra individual accounts; enterprise Gemini Code Assist licences and API-key authentication were announced as unaffected (free-tier API-key behaviour was not stated, so verify it before relying on it). Check which account mode a gemini invocation uses before declaring the CLI unavailable.

decisions.notes: Verified against the Antigravity headless documentation and CodeRabbit review 5568957759: active-workspace file access is allowed by default; the observed limitation was shell-command permission denial. Preserve the verified Gemini account-scope guidance append-only.
